newsitem.title: SPAIN: SWIMMING-GOLDEN RIVER DOUBLE FOR AKATIEV.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-GOLDEN RIVER DOUBLE FOR AKATIEV.

text.p: Alexei Akatiev achieved an outstanding golden double when he won a 25-kilometre river epic in the European swimming championships on Sunday two days after triumphing in the five kilometres.
Akatiev brought Russia their seventh gold in four days after breaking his rivals on the last of the five 5-km laps on the River Guadalquivir.
He stretched away to win by 3-1/2 minutes from Frenchman Stephane Lecat and German defending champion Christoph Wandratsch, who finished with hands clasped to share silver medals.
"It was something for German-French friendship," said Wandratsch, who beat Akatiev and Lecat by more than two minutes to win the 1995 European title in Vienna.
Akatiev retained his five-km title by just seven seconds on Friday evening but made sure there would be no challenge to his ambitions in the 25 kms.
The three were still together for the first half of the last lap but then the 23-year-old Russian, bronze medallist at the 1994 world championships, broke clear.
"When Akatiev left I couldn't follow. I didn't even try. He was too strong," Lecat said.
The Frenchman said Wandratsch had tried at first to chase the Russian but could not sustain a challenge.
Inside the last kilometre, with nearest challenger Claudio Gargaro of Italy safely behind, they agreed to settle for shares of silver.
"We smiled and said 'okay, together'," Lecat said.
"You do that sort of thing in friendship," Wandratsch said. "Akatiev was unbeatable today."
The flat calm of the river suited Akatiev, a swimmer who also competes in pool events.

The swimmers were extraordinarily closely-bunched for much of the race. A mere 22 seconds separated all but the last of the 18 starters after five kms and just seven seconds covered the first seven at 15 kms.

At the start of the final 5-km loop, Gargaro, Wandratsch, Lecat and Akatiev were some 20 seconds clear but then the Russian seized control, swimming the last five kms in under an hour to finish in exactly five hours and five minutes.
